cases.title: Group 变化后 Task Target 和 Node Detail 任务列表同步。
cases.decision: NOT_RUN/PARTIAL until the same owned node is actually moved between owned Groups and both Task target/UI views change consistently.
cases.why_existing_evidence_is_insufficient: Group list and Task target/table tests use empty static Groups or disabled no-Node Tasks. They cannot prove group membership changes alter a matching Node Detail task list.

flows: group the owned no-host Docker Node into Group A; disabled Task target Group A; verify Task target and Node Detail task list include the same Task
move that same owned Node to Group B; verify Group A Task no longer matches in Node Detail; use GETs/IDs to cross-check; do not HELLO/install/run
minimum_fixture_plan.gating_note: Use one uniquely named/IP no-host Docker Node only after a separate concrete grant; never modify protected Node membership. Task target switches between the two owned Group IDs; no Run.

cases.title: Target label：key/value、匹配节点变化。
cases.decision: NOT_RUN/PARTIAL; current zero-owned-Node fixture evidence cannot validate label matching or membership changes.
cases.why_existing_evidence_is_insufficient: The disabled Task target-label case needs a real Node with a known label and positive/negative matching result. Empty Groups and zero-Node Task pagination do not provide that oracle.

minimum_fixture_plan.shared_fixture_with_P06_08: one uniquely owned no-host Docker Node with a GET-verified safe label, two owned Groups, one owned disabled Command Task reused sequentially for group-target and label-target flows
label_flow: GET exact Node label key/value; set Task target to that exact pair; verify matching Node through actual UI/API metadata; change only the owned Task target value to a fresh nonmatch and verify it disappears; do not mutate protected Node labels
minimum_fixture_plan.gating_note: If the pending no-host Docker Node has no server-visible labels, do not infer a match and do not install/HELLO it. Keep P09P11-11 PARTIAL until an independently authorized label-bearing owned fixture is available.

summary.partial_or_evidence-gap: P09P11-01 (task list-row View linkage); P12P13-01 (row-level fields vs exact GET); P06-08 (needs 1 owned Node + 2 Groups + 1 disabled Task); P09P11-11 (needs known actual Node labels; can share same future fixture only if present)
